page.overview:
Who is Murray Mag'Nesson?

is a dwarf wizard played by Marisha Ray in Campaign Four.

Murray appears "put together" but is also a little grimy and greasy. She has long auburn hair, a braided chin-strap beard, and a large bust. She wears a long colorful sleeveless duster coat, a wide flat-brimmed hat, and a custom-made quill on her index fingernail. She is missing her three right-front teeth, which have been replaced with gemstones; left-to-right is a ruby, clear/white quartz and purple quartz. She wears a corset.

Murray enjoys a good party, and a good funeral. She cares deeply about fairness in magical education, wanting students of the Penteveral to be allowed equal opportunity to learn and grow, regardless of their background.

Marisha Ray described her as "that friend that everyone has where they are the first person to get sloppy at the bar, even though they're wearing designer clothes, and just when you think they're going to hit the floor, she drops a deep philosophical line, referencing Camus or something." She agrees with the philosophy of the Penteveral that knowledge should be accessible to anyone who is willing to work hard enough for it, and resents the changes being forced on the school by the current government of Dol-Makjar. Murray believes strongly in freedom of all kinds, and will take issue with any threat to or manipulation of those freedoms. Campaign 4 Ep 1-4 Recap]" | vod=https://youtu.be/hdLPwuKMlIY | 12:56}}
